annotations.title: Act on a scene on air

description: Acts on the scene on air, as its operator would: goFrame (take frame/<target> to air, with a transition), next (cue frame/<target> so the take is instant; no target clears the cue), setControl (set one of its controls; scene_get control/* lists them), setData (replace a table's rows), skip (a playlist source to its next item). Viewers see it at once. The arguments are checked first, then against what is published (a frame, control, table or playlist source it doesn't have, a toggle given "yes": INVALID_INPUT); only then is it refused while nothing plays it (SCENE_OFFLINE). A SCENE_TIMEOUT may or may not have applied: send an actionId (a new uuid per action, kept by you) and retry with the SAME actionId and arguments — it is applied at most once. Without an actionId, never retry an action that isn't idempotent (skip, a button) blind: read get_scene_state first. Needs a stream playing the published scene (set_stream_scene, start_stream); it changes what is on air, never the draft. Answers streamId, online, frame (on air after the action) and next.

actionId.description: Your id for this one action (a new uuid each time): a retry with the same actionId applies it at most once

controlId.description: setControl: the control's id, the <id> of control/<id>; scene_get control/* lists them

op.description: The action: take a frame to air, cue the next frame, set a control, replace a table's rows, or skip a playlist source to its next item

rows.description: setData: the new rows, each an object of column → value; they replace every row the table has now

scene.description: The scene (scn_…), from list_scenes or create_scene.

sourceId.description: setData: the table's id (as in source/data/<id>); skip: the playlist source's id (default: the scene's first)

streamId.description: The stream (stream_…) to act on, from get_scene_state; needed only when more than one stream plays the scene

target.description: goFrame, next: which frame, by the id in its path frame/<id>

anyOf.description: The transition style; cut is instant

kind.description: The transition style; cut is instant

transition.description: goFrame: how it cuts — a kind, or { kind, ms } (default: the frame's own)

value.description: setControl: the value (a toggle true or false, a text a string, a number a number, a select one of its options; none for a button)

name: control_scene

frame.description: The frame/<id> on air, after the action

online.description: Whether the stream is on air

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it
